content.text: `tools.edit` requires `old_string` to appear exactly once; maybe the strings are split across lines or not exactly (we appended with line breaks). The hashes in our entries are on one line each, e.g., `SHA256 DD4C...`; the `old` string should match. But maybe our appended content was written with the here-string and has leading indentation or the hash wrapped? Let's grep for the old hash.
